worldVersion.description: The version of this file's format; the game refuses a newer one

seed.description: The seed of the land. The edits below belong to the land this seed makes; a game with another seed does not apply them

generator.description: The generator settings that differ from assets/data/sim/region.json, by their names there. Empty: the settings of region.json

mountainLevel.description: Elevation above this is mountain (at least 100 above lakeLevel)

caveNoise.description: A mountain tile above this is a cave mouth

edgeWall.description: Tiles of mountain around the region

flintPerMille.description: Flint patches near water and caves, per thousand tiles

woodPerMille.description: Trees on forest tiles, per thousand

berriesPerMille.description: Berry bushes at forest edges, per thousand

herdPerMille.description: Herds on steppe, per thousand tiles

herdMinimum.description: The fewest animals in a herd

herdMaximum.description: The most animals in a herd

berryRegrowDays.description: Days before a picked berry bush bears again

startNeedWithin.description: Tiles: the start has water and food this close

overrides.description: What differs from the land the seed makes: painted tiles, and things put on the land or taken off it

chunks.description: Painted tiles, one list for each chunk the owner painted in, named "cx,cy" (chunk column and row). Only tiles that differ from the seed are listed

additionalProperties.description: The painted tiles of one chunk, in tile order

x.description: The tile's column inside its chunk (0 to chunkSize - 1)

y.description: The tile's row inside its chunk (0 to chunkSize - 1)

things.description: Plants, animals and objects put on the land, and the seed's own wood, berries, flint or herds taken away

id.description: A stable id, kept through every save and every regeneration of the land

kind.description: A plant, object or animal kind from its catalog (a taken-away seed thing names wood, berries, flint or herd)

remove.description: Take away the seed's own thing at this tile (a tombstone: regeneration cannot bring it back)

forced.description: Keep an entry where the site check fails (used by camps, US-205)

properties.description: What this one thing sets over its kind: hp (an animal), or <interaction>.duration and <interaction>.delay in whole seconds (a plant)

people.description: People put on the land; the game makes each one when the region loads, with the same id every time

id.description: A stable id, kept through every save and every regeneration of the land

kind.description: A character kind from the characters catalog

name.description: The person's own name; empty: the name of the kind

properties.description: What this one person sets over its kind: hp, swordDamage, family (whole numbers), attitude (one word), tags (words separated by commas)

places.description: Named places a quest, a dialogue or a schedule can point to

id.description: A stable id, kept through every save and every regeneration of the land

kind.description: What sort of place it is; it becomes the place's first tag (shrine, meeting ground, grave, market, well)

name.description: The name a quest marker and a dialogue use; unique in the world, without : , or ;

properties.description: What this place sets: tags (words separated by commas)

camps.description: Clan camps: the player's start and the rival clans' starting camps

id.description: A stable id, kept through every save and every regeneration of the land

kind.description: player: where the hero's clan starts (at most one); rival: a rival clan starts here

name.description: A rival clan's name; empty: the generator picks one

forced.description: Placed anyway where the site check fails (no water and food within reach); it is not a conflict

properties.description: What this camp sets: people, a rival's starting size (1 to 100)

resources.description: Flint, wood, berries and herds: how many can be taken at a spot of the seed, or a new spot where the seed has none

id.description: A stable id, kept through every save and every regeneration of the land

properties.description: What this spot sets: amount (1 to 1000), how many can be taken there; a herd's amount is its animals
